name: Shillong
description: The capital of Meghalaya known for its rolling hills, cafes, lakes and a lively music culture.
local_tips: Try local Khasi cuisine at Police Bazar and explore Laitumkhrah for cafes.

name: Cherrapunji
description: A misty hill town famous for some of the world's highest rainfall, deep valleys and iconic waterfalls.
local_tips: Carry rain gear year-round; viewpoints get cloudy quickly.

name: Mawlynnong
description: Known as Asia's cleanest village, offering bamboo walkways, viewpoints and a living root bridge.
local_tips: Walk through the village early morning for the best experience.

name: Dawki
description: A small town near the Bangladesh border famous for the crystal-clear Umngot River.
local_tips: Visit before noon for the clearest river visibility.

name: Mawsynram
description: One of the wettest places on Earth, surrounded by lush hills, caves and cloud-filled valleys.
local_tips: Carry waterproof shoes if visiting outside winter.

name: Jowai
description: A scenic town in the Jaintia Hills known for crystal lakes, green plateaus and serene landscapes.
local_tips: Visit Thadlaskein Lake during sunset.

name: Nongriat
description: The base village for the Double Decker Living Root Bridge trek, known for jungles and natural pools.
local_tips: The 3,000-step descent is steep; start early to avoid heat.

name: Laitlum Canyons
description: A dramatic canyon viewpoint offering panoramic ridges, deep gorges and sweeping cloud views.
local_tips: Cloud cover appears suddenly—aim for early morning.

name: Umiam Lake
description: A serene reservoir surrounded by pine forests, popular for boat rides and lakeside resorts.
local_tips: Stop at the viewpoint while driving from Guwahati to Shillong.

name: Elephant Falls
description: A popular three-tiered waterfall on the outskirts of Shillong surrounded by greenery.
local_tips: The stairs may be slippery during monsoon.

name: Ward's Lake
description: A small artificial lake in central Shillong ideal for peaceful walks and boating.
local_tips: Visit in the evening for a relaxed stroll.

name: Mawsmai Cave
description: A short limestone cave with narrow passages, stalactites and unique rock formations.
local_tips: Wear shoes with good grip; parts of the cave are low.

name: Nohkalikai Falls
description: One of India's tallest plunge waterfalls with a dramatic turquoise pool.
local_tips: Afternoons often get foggy—visit before noon.

name: Seven Sisters Falls
description: A group of seven segmented waterfalls flowing down a tall limestone cliff.
best_time: July to September for full flow
local_tips: Not impressive in winter; best seen during monsoon.

name: Dainthlen Falls
description: A scenic waterfall with local legends about the defeat of a giant serpent.
local_tips: Go near sunset for golden-hour photos.

name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge
description: A famous two-layered living root bridge accessible through a steep trek from Cherrapunji.
local_tips: Carry water; the trek has over 3,000 steep steps.

name: Living Root Bridge (Mawlynnong)
description: A photogenic root bridge near Asia’s cleanest village.
local_tips: Combine the visit with Sky View Tower.

name: Umngot River
description: A crystal-clear river known for transparent boating experiences.
local_tips: Avoid weekends due to crowds.

name: Bangladesh Viewpoint
description: A viewpoint overlooking plains of Bangladesh from atop Meghalaya’s hills.
local_tips: Clearer views post-monsoon.

name: Mawphlang Sacred Forest
description: An ancient, sacred forest protected by local Khasi traditions with rare flora.
local_tips: A guided tour enhances the experience.

name: Krang Suri Falls
description: A stunning blue waterfall with a refreshing swimming pool.
local_tips: Life jackets are mandatory for swimming.

name: Thalangkai Natural Bridge
description: A lesser-known living root bridge offering a peaceful nature escape.
local_tips: Few tourists visit here; great for photography.

name: Pung Pond
description: A calm lake surrounded by forests, popular among locals for picnics.
local_tips: Bring snacks; no shops nearby.

name: Thadlaskein Lake
description: A scenic lake tied to local legends, ideal for peaceful evenings.
local_tips: Beautiful light around golden hour.

name: Krem Liat Prah
description: One of India's longest caves, known for massive chambers and adventure caving.
local_tips: Only for experienced trekkers with a guide.

name: Krem Mawmluh
description: A cave with unique rock formations and wet sections formed by underground streams.
local_tips: Wear waterproof shoes; the cave is slippery.

name: Mawkdok Dympep Valley
description: A dramatic V-shaped valley popular for its zip lining and panoramic views.
local_tips: Try ziplining for a great view.

name: Weisawdong Falls
description: A breathtaking three-tier waterfall accessed via a steep forest trail.
local_tips: The trail is slippery; avoid monsoon.

name: Nongkhnum Island
description: One of the largest river islands in Asia, featuring sandy river shores and scenic cliffs.
local_tips: Carry snacks and water; limited facilities.

name: Trekking
description: Popular treks include Double Decker Root Bridge, Laitlum Canyon hikes and rural village trails.

name: Caving
description: Meghalaya has some of India’s longest and most challenging caves.

name: Waterfall Hopping
description: Visit iconic waterfalls like Nohkalikai, Krang Suri and Seven Sisters.

name: Boating
description: Transparent river boating at Dawki’s Umngot River is a must-do.
